title: Skill Mastery
notes: NEW: Skill Mastery. Train each skill and your ultimate up to Mastery 10 with Gold and Mana Stones, +12% damage per level (Champion tab). Use the damage split after fights to see which skill pays off.
From B-Rank on, your hero stands in a rotating rune circle in your rank colour on the home screen, with more rings and sparks the higher you climb.
Balance: late bosses (Frost Matriarch, Abyss King, Storm Lord, Sunken Queen, Eclipse Emperor) have less HP, all elites have 20% less HP, Sunken Sun and Eclipse Throne are a bit softer.
